systems: Terraform — plan -out binds the plan to the state's lineage/serial; apply tfplan refuses a stale plan without prompting and does not refresh; the plan is the review
Pulumi — up --plan constrains the engine to the plan and evaluates live state at execution time; prompts by default
Ansible — no saved-plan artefact; --check and --diff are dry runs over live hosts, so a stale delta is never applied from a file
crux.verdict: at the Terraform default after this branch: the plan is hash-bound, every gate the interactive apply runs (except the mutating live probe) runs, and the destructive prompt runs; the live evaluation Pulumi performs is the recorded gap (#432)
